note_ko: 장소 디테일 기준(docs/장소팩_작성기준.md)에 따라 작성. {s}/{S}=she/She, {p}/{P}=her/Her, {o}=her, {lit}=빛이 닿는 의상 부분.
setting_en: a small neighborhood café with warm wooden tables, a long counter and tall front windows
feature_en: a round wooden table with a ceramic cup and saucer on it
a woven rattan chair pulled out beside the table
ground_en: small square cement tiles near the entrance
far_en: a long wooden counter with an espresso machine and a row of glass jars
shelves of ceramic cups and coffee bags along the back wall

해질녘 창가.time_en: the last orange hour of the afternoon
